name: Matsukawa Kou
source:
Hobby: Training and Studying Kabuki

[url=/c46076]Iori's[/url] younger brother who still appreciates Kabuki.
His relationship with his brother was broken for a long time, but thanks to the help of the protagonist they reconcile.
A pure and serious guy, but he tends to overthink things.
